question: The heart of a fish has ______ chambers.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Two**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Fishes have a two-chambered heart. The heart consists of an atrium and a single ventricle.
 
• The atrium receives blood and the ventricle is responsible for pumping 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The oxygenation of blood happens through the gills.
 
• The circulation in fishes is also a single circulation in a single direction - unidirectional flow

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4018b24fc4ff9ab89448059265eba10d236850c795a073bbd5d234d34d39c42.png]
